description: On one dynaset over F (IDs 1-8; N 10,20,30,40,40,50,60,70; S alpha, beta, O'Brien, a"b, abc, ABC, abd, Null; D with a time part, a repeated date and Nulls; Q x, Null, y), for each criterion [S = 'alpha' ;; S = 'ALPHA' ;; S = 'alpha ' ;; S = 'O''Brien' ;; S = "O'Brien" ;; S = 'O'Brien' ;; S = 'a"b' ;; S = "a""b" ;; S = "a"b" ;; S = ''' ;; S = '' ;; S = "" ;; S = 'abc' ;; S > 'abc' ;; S < 'b' ;; S = [S] ;; S = 'Zed' ;; [S] = 'beta' ;; S = 'beta ;; S = beta ;; S = 'be' & 'ta' ;; S = 'a' + 'lpha' ;; S = Left('alphabet', 5)]: FindFirst, then FindNext x1, with the same criterion; after each call read NoMatch, BOF, EOF and ID. Asks quote and escape handling in text criteria, case and trailing-space comparison, comparison operators on text, field-to-field and function-built text, and which malformed texts are refused, with the second match after FindNext. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
